name: After § 76
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 76c. Calls for enhanced cooperation with Western Balkan countries in the area of defence industries; emphasises that Western Balkan countries have significant expertise in defence industries and that the EU should consider procuring military equipment from Western Balkan countries; emphasises that this approach would help make Western Balkan countries stronger allies of the EU;
